column1: # Consequence set, generation 1. Sealed. See README.md for what "blind" means
# here and for the parameters, which were committed in d0600d9 before a single
# One phenomenon: a person states a fact, then the errand that fact creates.
# Ids are in blocks of five by connector, fixed in advance and not chosen per
# capture: CQ01-05 "and", CQ06-10 "so", CQ11-15 "which means", CQ16-20 a bare
# comma, CQ21-25 "then", CQ26-30 "that means", CQ31-35 "because of that",
# CQ36-40 no connector at all. Within each block the domains run household,
# `expected_destination` names the destination of the ERRAND on a two-thought
# row. This file cannot say "the fact to Memory and the errand to Today",
# because no column for a per-thought destination exists -- the same gap the
# devsets README records for cut points. Read the thought count as the
# measurement here and the destination as context: an errand is Today almost
# by definition, so destination barely varies and barely discriminates.
